entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support'.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to return something. My order number is VF88301.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now... I see an order for the Pro-Lace cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?

They just... they don't work for me. I've tried everything. I adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but no matter what I do, they just give me horrible blisters on my heels. I can't even ride for an hour.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want when you're trying to enjoy a ride. Let me just check the purchase date here... one moment.
Please, I hope you can help. I've been a loyal customer for years and I really needed this money back for some other bills. I feel so bad about this.
I understand completely. Okay, I've reviewed your order and the good news is that you're well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely process a full refund for these cycling shoes.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much!

Of course. I've just emailed you a pre-paid return shipping label. Just box up the shoes, attach the label, and drop them at any post office. Once we receive them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You have no idea how much this helps. Thank you, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
